close_reason: The motivating seal runaway no longer exists, and a two-tier provisional-publication model would duplicate consistency ownership. fz-kdt.34 now owns the single generic concept: monotone current cells plus a quiescent group epoch for consumers requiring finality.
description:
Closed as a redundant consistency model.

The motivating seal runaway no longer exists. A separate provisional-publication tier would duplicate ownership with the reactive fact graph.

fz-kdt.34 owns the single replacement invariant: peers may consume monotone current cell values, while consumers requiring finality wait on the same dependency group's quiescent epoch. No independent implementation remains here.
title: Deadlock-safe settled-gating of downstream-visible replacing facts: the scheduler cannot mark partial evidence provisional
